kodi._comment_instances: multi-instance: add an 'instances' array of {url, username, password, self_signed_cert, name}; every instance is polled and whichever plays first owns the presence until it stops. When non-empty, the top-level url/username/password above are ignored.
kodi._comment_urls: urls: alternate base URLs for one server (same credentials); each becomes a polled instance and trumps url. Also accepted per instances[] entry.
kodi._comment_poster_source: episodes poster_source: season (season poster, then series), series (series poster only), or episode (episode still, no poster lookups).
kodi._comment: blacklist libraries matches against Kodi file paths (substrings). Media types: music, movie, episode, livetv, unknown (aliases: audio/song/musicvideo, tvchannel/channel, plugin)
